fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Applicants must have completed at least the first year of their current study programme during the exchange, remain registered at home university, be non-Chinese citizens aged 18-45 (graduate-year students are not recommended to apply).

eligible_majors.notes: Excel agreement scope specifies AUC School 'GAPP' rather than 'University-wide'.

value: MBA / Master in International Relations / Master in Public Policy / LLM in Chinese Law / Yenching Academy special English graduate programs
excluded_majors.notes: Chinese-taught Master's courses require departmental permission; faculties with special prerequisites excluded.

min_gpa_host.notes: No fixed numeric host GPA cutoff appears in PKU Fact Sheet 2020-21 or on verified PKU web pages.

instruction_languages.notes: Courses primarily taught in Chinese at UG/Master levels; select English-taught courses offered.

english_course_availability.notes: Fact sheet p.3 notes instruction is mainly Chinese with some English-taught courses available (reference list at http://dean.pku.edu.cn/englishcourses/index.html).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Fact sheet p.3 states English test proof is not required during the application process, though select English-taught courses/departments may require proficiency verification or test scores (RHET 1020 policy not mentioned).

host_language_requirement.value: Chinese HSK Level 6 (over 70 points per item) required for Chinese-taught UG/GR courses; NO Chinese proficiency required for Chinese language training courses.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2020-2021 reference calendar (Fact Sheet p.2; check http://www.pku.edu.cn/campuslife/xl/index.htm for 2026-27 dates): Autumn semester Sep 14 - Jan 17.
fall_term_dates.notes: General PKU Fall semester runs early September through mid-January.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2020-2021 reference calendar (Fact Sheet p.2; check http://www.pku.edu.cn/campuslife/xl/index.htm for 2026-27 dates): Spring semester Feb 22 - Jun 27.
spring_term_dates.notes: General PKU Spring semester runs late February through late June.

final_semester_allowed.notes: PKU Fact Sheet p.3 states: 'Students in the graduate year at home university are NOT recommended to apply' (not an explicit absolute ban).

tuition_model.notes: Fact sheet p.5 states: 'Normally exchange students do not pay any application, tuition or administrative fees as per the university bilateral agreement.' Verified on isd.pku.edu.cn.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: PKU Fact Sheet p.5 lists general monthly living expenses of 1,000-3,000 RMB/month EXCLUDING accommodation (Global Village dorm 3,300-4,500 RMB/mo or off-campus 2,000-5,000 RMB/mo; bilateral agreements may cover free housing per p.4). Live ISD guide (https://www.isd.pku.edu.cn/en/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=lists&catid=31) lists annual estimates of RMB 15,000 food, RMB 5,000 misc, and RMB 35,000 accommodation.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint CNY 2,000/month (1,000-3,000 CNY/month excluding accommodation) * 5 months = CNY 10,000; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 7.3738 CNY & 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 CNY = 0.14988201 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 1,498.82 USD (excludes dorm 3,300-4,500 CNY/mo unless covered by bilateral agreement).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Application, tuition, and administrative fees normally waived under bilateral agreements. Exchange students MUST purchase the designated Chinese medical insurance plan at CNY 400 per semester.

housing_availability.notes: If covered by bilateral exchange agreement, a shared room at Zhongguanyuan Global Village is automatically allocated upon arrival; otherwise students apply online via studyatpku.com in mid-Jul / mid-Jan (~3,300-4,500 RMB/mo) or rent off campus (~2,000-5,000 RMB/mo).

housing_notes.value: Global Village (Zhong Guan Xin Yuan) on-campus dorms ~3,300-4,500 RMB/month (shared facilities, automatic if agreement covers free dorms; else online booking mid-Jul/mid-Jan via studyatpku.com); off-campus ~2,000-5,000 RMB/month (Ziroom/BeijingBuddy).
housing_notes.notes: Monthly rent rates and booking timeline on data/raw/factsheets/Peking University/Fact Sheet PKU 2020-2021 (updated).pdf#page=5.

citizenship_restrictions.value: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, aged between 18 and 45.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: PKU 2020-21 Fact Sheet p.1/p.5 references ISD (http://www.isd.pku.edu.cn/) for incoming student visa onboarding; exact live pku.edu.cn visa subpage URL was not surfaced in plain text (X1/X2 student visa & JW201/JW202 rules managed via ISD).

exchange_page_url.notes: ISD website: https://isd.pku.edu.cn; online portal: http://www.studyatpku.com.

course_catalog_url.notes: Also course preview at http://dean.pku.edu.cn/jiaoxuejihua/kcbxs.php?ll=1 (p.3); next-semester lists posted mid-Jan / mid-Jul.

credit_system_and_load.value: Chinese academic credit system (16-week semester; 1 credit = 1 class hour/week): Chinese-language track requires min 18 class hrs/week (2-5 courses); regular UG/GR coursework load is 6-20 credits (2-10 courses) per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Excluded: Health Science Center, School of Software & Microelectronics, Shenzhen Graduate School (case-by-case), special English Master's (MBA, MIR, MPP, LLM, Yenching), double-degree/tailor-made programmes. Chinese-taught Master's courses require faculty permit; departments retain right to restrict course enrollment.

value: Home university email nomination + official paper nomination letter
Original English-version hard copies mailed via home international office
Language proof if required (HSK 6 for Chinese-taught degree courses)

campus_type.notes: Historic Yanyuan main campus at No. 5 Yiheyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing (no strict urban/suburban label in verified schema terms).

international_support_services.value: Office of International Relations (OIR, exchange@pku.edu.cn) and International Students Division (ISD Room 330 New Sun Student Center, study@pku.edu.cn) handle nominations, Global Village dorm placement, orientation Chinese placement interviews, and visa documents.
international_support_services.notes: Orientation and ISD services on p.4-5.

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn / Full Year: Nomination deadline March 30; Online application Feb 20 - Apr 15. Spring Semester: Nomination deadline October 30; Online application Sep 20 - Nov 15.
nomination_deadlines.notes: 2026-27 web cycle retains Mar 30 / Apr 15 and Oct 30 / Nov 15.
